tools.name: supadata_transcript
tools.title: Get Video Transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript (what is said) of a video or post on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) or Facebook, or of an audio or video file URL. Not for ordinary web pages: use supadata_scrape for those. For large files, returns a jobId instead of the transcript directly - use supadata_check_transcript_status with that jobId to poll for results.

url.description: URL of a single video or post on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) or Facebook, or a direct link to an audio or video file. Not for ordinary web pages (use supadata_scrape).

lang.description: Preferred transcript language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. "en". Falls back to the first available language.

text.description: true returns the transcript as plain text; false (default) returns timestamped segments.

chunkSize.description: Maximum characters per timestamped segment (at least 50). Ignored when text is true.

mode.description: "native" only fetches an existing transcript, "generate" always transcribes with AI, "auto" (default) tries native first and falls back to generate.

tools.name: supadata_check_transcript_status
tools.title: Check Transcript Job Status
tools.description: Check transcript job status and retrieve results. Returns status: "queued", "active", "completed", or "failed". If status is not "completed" or "failed", call this tool again after a few seconds with the same id.

id.description: The job id returned by supadata_transcript.

tools.name: supadata_scrape
tools.title: Scrape Web Page
tools.description: Fetch a single web page and return its main content as Markdown, along with the page title, description and the links it contains. Use this to read or summarize a specific URL. To find which pages exist on a site, use supadata_map; to fetch many pages at once, use supadata_crawl. Costs 1 credit.

url.description: Full URL of the web page, including https://. Use a URL you know exists; to find pages on a site, use supadata_map.

noLinks.description: true leaves out the list of links found on the page.

lang.description: Preferred page language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. "en", for sites that serve several languages.

tools.name: supadata_map
tools.title: Map Website URLs
tools.description: List the URLs found on a website without fetching their content. Use this to discover a site's pages before choosing which ones to read with supadata_scrape, or to check a site's size before starting a supadata_crawl. Costs 1 credit.

url.description: Full URL of the website to map, including https://.

tools.name: supadata_crawl
tools.title: Start Website Crawl
tools.description: Create a crawl job to extract content from all pages on a website. Not available on every Supadata plan; if it returns upgrade-required, tell the user rather than retrying. Returns a jobId - use supadata_check_crawl_status with that jobId to poll for results.

url.description: Full URL to start crawling from, including https://.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (1-5000, default 100). Each page costs 1 credit.

tools.name: supadata_check_crawl_status
tools.title: Check Crawl Job Status
tools.description: Check crawl job status and retrieve results. Returns status: "scraping", "completed", "failed", or "cancelled". If status is "scraping", call this tool again after a few seconds with the same id.

id.description: The job id returned by supadata_crawl.

tools.name: supadata_metadata
tools.title: Get Media Metadata
tools.description: Fetch metadata from a media URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook). Returns platform info, title, description, author details, engagement stats, media details, tags, and creation date. Use this for details about a video or post; use supadata_transcript for what is said in it.

url.description: URL of a single video or post on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) or Facebook.

tools.name: supadata_extract
tools.title: Extract Structured Data from Video
tools.description: Extract structured data from a video URL using AI. Provide a prompt for what to extract, a JSON Schema for the output format, or both. Returns a jobId for async processing - use supadata_check_extract_status with that jobId to poll for results.

url.description: URL of a single video or post on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) or Facebook.

prompt.description: What to extract from the video, in plain language.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the output format. Provide this, prompt, or both.

tools.name: supadata_check_extract_status
tools.title: Check Extract Job Status
tools.description: Check extract job status and retrieve results. Returns status: "queued", "active", "completed", or "failed". If status is not "completed" or "failed", call this tool again after a few seconds with the same id.

id.description: The job id returned by supadata_extract.
